notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content: [p]The first demo of [b]Path of the RNGesus[/b] is now available! There are 35 items, 20 perks and 20 encounters to conquer, with 3 difficulties and 1 special challenge to unlock! This translates to a couple hours of gameplay. The demo will be available for the next 3-4 weeks, receiving some small content updates and bug fixes in preparation for the game's full release. [/p][p][/p][p]During this time, you can leave feedback and suggestions by taking our [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdSQ7QPu97B9LTptb_XSvF2kYGkDOEfqH04GO4v_v2QnIf5NA/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=107547223848371492916"]demo survey[/url]. If you do so, you can choose to leave a nickname to be featured in the game's credits! You can also interact with other players by joining the [url="https://discord.gg/QuMxzUqRqA"]game's Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you have fun with the demo! [i]Good luck on the Path![/i][/p]
